item.title: With non-SSL
item.description: Setting up an ingress for Traefik for the OIG domain on Kubernetes (non-SSL) The instructions below explain how to set up Traefik as an ingress for the OIG domain with non-SSL termination. Note: All the steps below should be performed on the administrative host. Install Traefik a. Configure the repository b. Create a namespace c. Install Traefik using helm d. Setup routing rules for the domain Create an ingress for the domain
